fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-07-27, a transport worker was allegedly waylaid near Alli Colony College Road in Vellore and cash of about Rs. 1,00,000 was taken from the complainant. The time of the incident was given as 21:55 on 2026-07-25. The online submission was made by Kannan Muthu (9000000430). Malathi Murugan (9000000027) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint mentions Yuvaraj Natarajan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000298, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly forced to stop on a lonely stretch before valuables were taken.
fields.Keywords: highway robbery, roadside, mobile number, witness, suspect, photograph, night, college road
